top_1_private_wealth_share.note: Top-tail private wealth data needed before full certification.

public_social_counterweight.note: HDB/CPF/state capacity create a powerful public-asset/service counterweight, but the pass depends on lease value, CPF liquidity, resale-price dynamics, and mobility/retirement conversion.

lower_half_real_floor.note: Household income and public-housing systems support a floor, but adequacy must be tested after CPF lock-up, caregiving, health, housing resale, and migrant/noncitizen exclusions.

early_foothold_open_access.note: Subsidized public housing can widen foothold access, but queue timing, eligibility, resale-price cycles, marriage/family rules, cash-over-valuation, and CPF balances remain threshold tests.

parent_backed_threshold_dependency.note: Needs data on parental help, resale entry, co-residence, and family grants/guarantees.

group_person_closure.note: Citizen/resident, household-type, age, single, divorce, migrant-worker, and caregiving distinctions must be anti-averaged before a national pass.

housing_land_washout.note: HDB market management lowers some exclusion risks, but resale-price inflation, lease decay, location stratification, and CPF housing drawdown can still convert housing into a washout surface.

debt_fee_washout.note: CPF/housing finance and loan rules need person-level stress testing.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Needs private top-tail, land, corporate, family-office, and political-control data.

ownership_legibility.note: HDB data are strong for public housing; private wealth/control channels remain proof debt.

climate_insurance_drag.note: not yet measured in this active bounded case.

digital_intangible_concentration.note: Relevant in a high-productivity financial/digital hub; not yet measured.

dynastic_infrastructure_pressure.note: Family-office, trust, and private-company data needed.

monetary_asset_price_channel.note: Interest-rate and resale price dynamics can affect public-housing assetization.

case_notes: Scoreboard verdict is for public-housing foothold surface, not full national wealth-order certification.

evidence_debt_register.question: CPF liquidity versus housing/retirement conversion
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure CPF balances used for housing, accrued interest, retirement adequacy, liquidity at shock moments, and lease-decay exposure.

evidence_debt_register.question: HDB entry, queue, resale, and eligibility thresholds
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Track BTO supply, application rates, resale prices, eligibility rules, family/marital status, and down-payment/cash needs.

evidence_debt_register.question: wealth inequality beyond income Gini
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Use MOF/SingStat wealth evidence to separate income equalization from asset concentration and household-balance-sheet risk.

evidence_debt_register.question: group/person anti-averaging
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Separate citizens, permanent residents, migrants, singles, elderly, divorced households, caregivers, disabled people, and household size.

evidence_debt_register.question: public asset governance and upside sharing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Trace how land value, HDB subsidies, grants, CPF, and resale rules allocate public upside and downside.

evidence_debt_register.question: care, health, and retirement shock conversion
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Test if household assets and CPF are available when care, illness, unemployment, or retirement threshold moments occur.

gate_07_public_common_counterweight.why: Singapore has unusually strong public-housing/state-capacity counterweights, but pass requires CPF liquidity, HDB access, wealth inequality, group anti-averaging, and lease/resale conversion proof.

gate_05_washout_reconcentration.why: HDB and CPF rails can still wash out into lease, resale, liquidity, retirement, and group-access constraints if not converted at threshold moments.
